newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy deserves place in EMU from start - Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy deserves place in EMU from start - Ciampi.

text.p: Italy is bringing its state accounts into line and deserves to be a founder member of planned European economic and monetary union (EMU), Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Thursday.

"Today the path (to stability) is in its final stages...which makes Italy worthy of taking part in the single currency from the start," Ciampi said in a speech to a group of politicians, businessmen and bankers.

The government last month unveiled an austerity budget for 1997, designed to enable Italy to meet tough financial criteria established in the Maastricht Treaty for countries wishing to sign up to EMU from the planned start in 1999. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
